title: Geno Smith will play for Jets in preseason game against Steelers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Geno Smith will play for Jets in preseason game against Steelers
sources.description: Jets quarterback Geno Smith will make his first start of the 2026 preseason Friday night against the Pittsburgh Steelers. Smith missed the Jets’ preseason opener against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers with a minor ankle injury.
